name: Waverley Country Club
architects: Jack Moffat routing (1898); H. Chandler Egan (1912-1924, current routing, bunkers and greens); restoration by Gil Hanse (c. 2012)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 96457214) bbox 1020 x 1389 m in UTM 10N, centred in 1280 x 1792 m (whole 256 m chunks): 130 m of scenery east and west, ~200 m north and south

scorecard_source: Club website scorecard page (screenshot from the developer, GitHub release waverley-data, Screenshot 2026-10-19 165314; copy in reference/club_scorecard_page.png). Every row adds up to its printed totals. Black plays hole 5 as a par 4 (par 71); Blue and White are par 72. Built from the Blue tees only (developer, 2026-10-19); Black and White are listed, not playable
attribution: Elevation and canopy: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Developer decisions 2026-10-19: Blue tees only; every penalty area red; the Willamette is a red penalty area (not out of bounds); the driving range is away from the course and not modelled; theme like pnw with slightly nicer turf and whiter sand. OSM has the boundary, 18 fairways, one pond and the clubhouse only: hole lines, greens, tees, bunkers and pins are traced (Indian Island procedure); hole identity from the club's course layout map (reference/club_course_layout.png). OSM spells the club 'Waverly'; the club and the logo id use 'Waverley'.

green_tilt.note: developer 2026-10-19: 'green slopes back to front strongly'; the lidar plane over the green tilts 6.5 % towards the tee. Cap raised from 2.5 % to 3.5 %, no random undulations

red_water_note: the pond between holes 11, 12 and 13 (OSM natural=water, way 432810024) is a red penalty area (developer 2026-10-19: all water red)

drop_trees.reason: developer 2026-10-21: trees right in front of the hole 10 tee, removed; the lidar canopy model has them but the OSIP 2024 photo shows open grass there (likely gone since the flight) (23 m, 20 m out, 8 m left of the line)
